_comment: THE CROSS-LANGUAGE PIN for the book slug.
The slug exists twice on purpose — once per language:
They MUST agree exactly. The Python one writes the keys of
site/shelf_book_map.json; the JS one computes the key it looks up. If they
drift by one character the lookup misses, shelfLinkFor() returns null, and
EVERY shelf button silently disappears — no error, no console warning, just
1,082 books that quietly stop offering the shelf.
Both test suites read this file:
Add a case here and BOTH languages are held to it.
